answer: Proof of Agent deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications. In this network, each agent's execution kernel verifies cluster bottlenecks across a sparse interaction graph resembling a dense nebula. If an attacker fabricates identities, cut analysis isolates the fake cluster and triggers automated stake slashing, locking malicious collateral into a frozen glacier. This mechanism imposes a superlinear attacker cost relative to Sybil count.
